thread:
maria_support: heads up — customer acct-881 reporting refund flow failing. our autorouter invoked `adjust_balance` instead of `issue_refund`. customer expected money back but we wrote an adjustment.

maria_support: repro steps they gave:
1) POST /v1/support/action with natural language: "please refund $42 to customer"
2) payload: `{\"customer_id\":\"acct-881\",\"amount\":42,\"currency\":\"USD\"}`
3) outcome: `adjust_balance` invoked, not `issue_refund`.

kevin_oncall: can you paste the exact request body + any router decision log?

maria_support: pasted below (redacted customer info):
```
{
  "text":"please refund $42 to customer",
  "context":{},
  "parsed_args":{"customer_id":"acct-881","amount":42}
}
```
router log (excerpt):
```
[router] input_hash=0x8a3b select_tool=adjust_balance score=0.62 alt_tool=issue_refund score=0.41 reason=fuzzy_name_match
```

infra-bot: noted — automated heuristic used: fuzzy alias match on signature + description.

jessica_eng: looks like a classic signature/alias collision. both `adjust_balance` and `issue_refund` share fields `amount` and `customer_id` and have short descriptions. router fallback to fuzzy text-match picks adjust. quick checks: 1) do a curl repro hitting the autorouter 2) dump resolver candidates. try: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/router -d '{"text":"refund $42","customer_id":"acct-881","amount":42}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer DEV'
```

kevin_oncall: ran curl — reproducible locally. got same log: select_tool=adjust_balance score=0.63 issue_refund=0.39. adding `"intent":"refund"` to payload picks `issue_refund` (score shift).

kevin_oncall: quick mitigation idea: prefer tools with explicit alias match or require `intent`/`action` when ambiguous. we can also nudge resolver to boost tools whose description contains the exact verb present in the user text (e.g., "refund","reimburse").

jessica_eng: longer term fixes: 1) tighten signature schemas so `issue_refund` requires `reason` (optional today) or rename alias to `create_refund` to reduce fuzzy overlap; 2) add negative aliases to `adjust_balance` (e.g., exclude words refund/return) so fuzzy scorer penalizes it; 3) adjust resolver thresholds — bump minimum delta to 0.2 for auto-select in prod.

ops_sre: customer impact — acct-881 was refunded incorrectly. operations is coordinating manual reversal. we need a hotfix in prod ASAP to avoid more incidents. can we ship a routing patch that adds a pre-filter mapping common verbs -> refund tool? that's low-risk and reversible.

jessica_eng: I can open a small PR to add a verb-mapping prefilter and a one-line boost to `issue_refund` when text contains refund/reimburse/return. will mark PR for emergency canary.

maria_support: please include the regression test (curl examples) and a check that adjust_balance is not chosen for any of the refund examples. also add a logging flag so we can audit any remaining misroutes.

kevin_oncall: assigned: jessica_eng -> ship prefilter + threshold bump, ops_sre -> apply canary + monitor, maria_support -> notify customer SLA update and coordinate manual fix. ETA for canary: 2 hours. full rollout after 24h validation.

jessica_eng: creating PR now and will paste link. tagging @ops_sre for rollout.
